row.cell: Right endpoint Riemann sum for y = \frac{x^{2}}{9} on \lbrack 2, 6 \rbrack

static.solution:
Solution:
(A) The left endpoint Riemann sum is f(2) \cdot 0.5 + f(2.5) \cdot 0.5 + \cdots + f(5.5) \cdot 0.5 = ( 0.444444444444444 + 0.694444444444444 + \cdots + 3.36111111111111 ) \cdot 0.5 = 6.83333.
(B) The right endpoint Riemann sum is f(2.5) \cdot 0.5 + f(3) \cdot 0.5 + \cdots + f(6) \cdot 0.5 = ( 0.694444444444444 + 1 + \cdots + 4 ) \cdot 0.5 = 8.61111.
